title: Comprehensive cross-browser & responsive QA sweep for UI Kit (Safari/Firefox/mobile) + triage
creator: Evelyn Nguyen
description: Perform a focused QA sweep of the current UI Kit tokens and components (buttons, tables, charts, form controls) across Safari (macOS and iOS), Firefox (desktop), and common mobile viewports. Goal: identify cross-browser layout regressions, token inconsistencies, and responsiveness issues; triage and prioritize fixes with engineering. Deliverable: consolidated bug list with repro steps, design fixes (token updates or CSS guidance), and a prioritized rollout plan.
scope: Visual/token parity (spacing, typography, color tokens) in Safari and Firefox
Responsive behavior for Buttons, Tables, and Chart wrappers at widths: 320, 375, 412, 768, 1024
Interaction states (hover/focus/active) on desktop across browsers
Touch hit areas and stacking context issues on iOS Safari
Performance-related regressions for charts (render flicker) in Firefox
ARIA label and keyboard navigation checks for form components
test_matrix: Responsive mode in Firefox and Safari developer tools
Touch emulation + real device spot checks (iPhone, Pixel)
bug_summary: BUG-UI-201: Safari - primary button text vertically misaligned at 14px when token spacing 'btn-padding-md' applied (repro: macOS Safari 17).
BUG-UI-202: Firefox - table header sticky column overlaps row action icons at 1024px breakpoints; likely z-index/sticky stacking context regression.
BUG-UI-203: iOS Safari - chart tooltip flickers and disappears on touch when using canvas-based charts; workaround: debounce pointer events.
BUG-UI-204: Mobile - select dropdown truncates long option labels on Android; token 'select-max-width' ignored in smaller viewports.
BUG-UI-205: Accessibility - focus ring not visible for secondary buttons in high-contrast mode in Firefox; contrast token usage inconsistent.
triage_notes: 03/03: Initial sweep completed by Aisha — recorded 18 total issues across browsers, 5 high-priority (see bug_summary).
03/05: Engineering (Liam Chen) confirmed reproduction for BUG-UI-202; root cause likely DOM reflow from virtualized table component. ENG ticket recommended: ENG-3124.
03/07: Design proposed token changes to btn-padding-md to add a 1px baseline offset for Safari text metrics; added Figma variant and token diff.
03/09: Decided to ship CSS fallback for chart tooltips immediately (patch PR #483) while longer-term chart library upgrade is scheduled under ENG-3188.
03/12: Prioritization meeting - final triage: BUG-UI-201 and BUG-UI-203 = P0 (regressions affecting multiple customers), BUG-UI-202 = P1, BUG-UI-204/205 = P2.
acceptance_criteria: All P0 issues have either a merged patch or an agreed engineering rollout plan with deadlines.
Design tokens updated in the repo and Figma with migration notes; token changes have automated tests or token mapping guidance.
Cross-browser playbook entry created that lists known quirks and recommended CSS fallbacks for Safari/Firefox (added to Confluence).
Smoke checklist included in release notes for the next design-system release verifying fixes across the test matrix.
next_steps: Aisha to open design token PR with visual diffs and storybook examples (target: 2026-03-16).
Engineering to open ENG-3124 (virtualized table z-index) and ENG-3188 (chart library upgrade) and link back here.
Create Playwright cross-browser regression tests for the five P0/P1 cases (owner: QA team) — initial seeds in repo/tests/playwright/cross-browser.spec.ts.
Schedule 30-min sync with Platform QA and frontend owners on 2026-03-17 to confirm rollout windows.
